ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.
